item.text: I’ll read the fixture, check every three-node placement, and apply the selection rules.

item.command:
/bin/zsh -lc "python3 -c 'import json,itertools
with open(\"input.json\") as f:
    d=json.load(f)
lat={tuple(sorted((p[\"a\"],p[\"b\"]))):p[\"ms\"] for p in d[\"latencies\"]}
feasible=[]
for ns in itertools.combinations(sorted(d[\"nodes\"],key=lambda n:n[\"id\"]),3):
    ids=[n[\"id\"] for n in ns]
    cost=sum(n[\"cost\"] for n in ns)
    if cost>d[\"budget\"] or any(lat[p]>d[\"max_pair_latency\"] for p in itertools.combinations(ids,2)):
        continue
    weights=[]
    for s in d[\"failures\"]:
        alive=[n for n in ns if n[\"site\"] not in s[\"sites\"] and n[\"provider\"] not in s[\"providers\"]]
        weight=sum(n[\"vote_weight\"] for n in alive)
        if weight<d[\"quorum\"] or not any(n[\"writable\"] for n in alive):
            break
        weights.append(weight)
    else:
        feasible.append({\"ids\":ids,\"cost\":cost,\"min_weight\":min(weights),\"scenario_weights\":weights})
selected=min(feasible,key=lambda p:(p[\"cost\"],-p[\"min_weight\"],p[\"ids\"]))
print(json.dumps({\"feasible_placements\":[p[\"ids\"] for p in feasible],\"selected\":selected[\"ids\"],\"selected_cost\":selected[\"cost\"],\"selected_min_surviving_weight\":selected[\"min_weight\"]},separators=(\",\",\":\")))
print(json.dumps(feasible,separators=(\",\",\":\")))'"
